audit.isbao_audit.v: IS-BAO registration needs an independent third-party audit
audit.isbao_audit.quote: requires an independent third-party audit to achieve the registration

audit.isbao_renewal.v: IS-BAO registration is renewed every two or three years

audit.aoc_what.v: an Air Operator Certificate (AOC) is the authority's safety approval that lets an operator carry out specified commercial air transport flights
audit.aoc_what.quote: an aviation safety instrument that authorises an operator to carry out specified commercial air transport

audit.aoc_needed.v: in Singapore an operator must hold a Singapore AOC to carry out commercial air transport
audit.aoc_needed.quote: must hold a Singapore AOC to conduct commercial air transport

audit.aoc_oversight.v: the regulator keeps inspecting AOC holders after the certificate is issued
audit.aoc_oversight.quote: CAAS conducts regular inspections to ensure AOC holders continue to meet safety and regulatory standards.

audit.faa_ask_certificate.v: the US FAA tells charter customers to ask to see the operator's certificate
audit.faa_ask_certificate.quote: ask to see the Operator's Air Carrier or Operating Certificate

audit.us_no_false_audit_claims.v: US rules forbid a broker to misstate that an operator meets an auditing organisation's standard
audit.us_no_false_audit_claims.quote: or that the air charter broker or any direct carriers to be used for a particular flight meets a standard set by an auditing organization.

empty.us_broker_definition.v: under US rules an air charter broker sells or arranges whole-aircraft charters flown by a direct air carrier
empty.us_broker_definition.quote: Air charter broker means a person or entity that, as an indirect air carrier, foreign indirect air carrier, or a bona fide agent, holds out, sells, or arranges single entity charter air transportation using a direct air carrier.

empty.single_entity.v: a single entity charter is the hire of the whole aircraft, paid for by the charterer rather than by individual passengers
empty.single_entity.quote: Single entity charter means a charter for the entire capacity of the aircraft, the cost of which is borne by the charterer

empty.ads_say_broker.v: in the US a broker's adverts, including web pages, must say it is a broker and not the airline in control of the aircraft
empty.ads_say_broker.quote: and that it is not a direct air carrier or a direct foreign air carrier in operational control of aircraft,

empty.licensed_carrier.v: the advert must also say the flight will be flown by a properly licensed carrier
empty.licensed_carrier.quote: and that the air service advertised shall be provided by a properly licensed direct air carrier or direct foreign air carrier.

empty.disclose_before_contract.v: a US broker must give certain disclosures before the contract for a flight is signed
empty.disclose_before_contract.quote: Before entering a contract for a specific flight or series of flights with charterers

empty.disclose_operator.v: one of them is the corporate name of the operator in operational control of the aircraft
empty.disclose_operator.quote: The corporate name of the direct air carrier or direct foreign air carrier in operational control of the aircraft

empty.disclose_before_flight.v: in every case the disclosures must be made before the flight starts
empty.disclose_before_flight.quote: In all circumstances, air charter brokers must disclose prior to the start of the air transportation

empty.refund.v: if the disclosures are not made in time, the customer may cancel and get a full refund
empty.refund.quote: receive a full refund of any monies paid for the charter air transportation and services

empty.electronic.v: the disclosures may be sent electronically
empty.electronic.quote: The six disclosures may be accomplished through electronic transmissions.

empty.rule_effective.v: the US air charter broker rule took effect on 14 February 2019

empty.positioning_counts.v: in Europe, a positioning flight flown by an AOC holder right before or after a commercial sector counts towards crew duty time
empty.positioning_counts.quote: aircraft positioning conducted by an AOC holder, immediately before or after a CAT sector counts as FDP and sector.

empty.dot_no_holding_out.v: US DOT guidance says brokers must not present themselves as airlines or operators
empty.dot_no_holding_out.quote: should take care not to hold out as "airlines," "air carriers," "operators,"

price.us_disclose_total.v: US rules make a broker disclose the total cost paid by the charterer to or through the broker
price.us_disclose_total.quote: The total cost of the air transportation paid by the charterer to or through the air charter broker

price.us_third_party_fees.v: they also make the broker disclose fees collected by third parties, such as fuel, landing and parking or hangar fees
price.us_third_party_fees.quote: including fuel, landing fees, and aircraft parking or hangar fees

price.us_fet_statute.v: US federal law taxes amounts paid for taxable air transport of persons at 7.5 percent
price.us_fet_statute.quote: a tax equal to 7.5 percent of the amount so paid

price.us_fet_irs.v: the IRS states the percentage tax as 7.5% of amounts paid for taxable air transport of persons
price.us_fet_irs.quote: The percentage tax is 7.5% of amounts paid for taxable transportation of persons by air.

price.us_segment.v: US law also charges a tax on each domestic flight segment
price.us_segment.quote: There is hereby imposed on the amount paid for each domestic segment of taxable transportation by air

price.us_charter_segment.v: for a chartered aircraft the IRS works out the segment tax by multiplying it by the number of passengers on board
price.us_charter_segment.quote: of taxable transportation is figured by multiplying the tax by the number of passengers transported on the aircraft.

price.us_international.v: a separate US tax applies to international air transport that begins or ends in the United States
price.us_international.quote: if the transportation begins or ends in the United States,

price.uk_apd_higher.v: UK Air Passenger Duty's higher rate applies to aircraft of 20 tonnes or more with fewer than 19 seats
price.uk_apd_higher.quote: The higher rate applies to flights aboard aircraft of 20 tonnes and above with fewer than 19 seats.

price.uk_apd_dates.v: the current UK APD rates apply to passengers carried on or after 1 April 2026
price.uk_apd_dates.quote: will have effect in relation to the carriage of chargeable passengers on or after 1 April 2026.

price.uk_apd_increase.v: the UK government announced a 50% increase to the APD higher rate
price.uk_apd_increase.quote: a 50% increase to the higher rate

price.changi_landing.v: at Singapore Changi, landing charges are based on the aircraft's maximum taxi weight
price.changi_landing.quote: The landing charges are based on the maximum taxi weight for each aircraft.

price.changi_parking.v: Changi charges aircraft parking per 24 hours, with the first 3 hours free
price.changi_parking.quote: The Parking Charges are charged per 24 hours or part thereof, with the first 3 hours free.

price.changi_passenger.v: Changi also lists passenger charges: a service and security fee, an aviation levy and an airport development levy
price.changi_passenger.quote: Passenger Service and Security Fee (PSSF), Aviation Levy (AL) and Airport Development Levy (ADL)

price.sg_gst_zero.v: international transport of passengers can be charged GST at 0% (zero-rated)
price.sg_gst_zero.quote: You can zero-rate your supply of services (i.e. charge GST at 0%) only if it falls within the description of international services under Section 21(3) of the GST Act.

price.sg_gst_routes.v: flights from Singapore abroad, from abroad to Singapore, and between two places outside Singapore
price.sg_gst_routes.quote: 3. from a place outside Singapore to another place outside Singapore.

eglf.self.v: the largest and the most pre-eminent business aviation airport in the UK
eglf.self.quote: The largest and the most pre-eminent business aviation airport in the UK

vhhh.permit.v: the operator needs a permit from the Director-General of Civil Aviation, applied for at least 3 working days before the flight, or at least 2 weeks ahead for a new or infrequent operator
vhhh.permit.quote: must obtain a permit from the Director-General of Civil Aviation ... at least 3 working days before the anticipated arrival/departure date ... at least 2 weeks prior to the date of operation
